meme-bot: meme result for "rivalry" https://meme.example/rivalry-cat.png

tyler: No objections. Also FYI my fantasy team just lost a player to injury so i might be a quiet observer this weekend.

alex: Okay plan set: meet at kitchen 6:15, submit bracket picks by 6:25, takeout arrives ~6:10-6:20. See you and bring plates/napkins!
